name: Unerring Needle
desc: Acuity 2 or more, Pressure 4 or more, Coherence 0.4 or more, Momentum 0, Inward at most 0.5. A piercing strike that cannot miss. Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Kinetic Bulwark
desc: Inertia 3 or more, Coherence 0.4 or more, Inward at most 0.4. Kinetic Bulwark: blocks all ranged attacks except light. Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Still Mind
desc: Inward 0.9 or more, Vitality 3 or more, with Momentum, Inertia, Acuity and Awareness at 0 and Coherence at most 0.5. Pure healing: all of the spell’s points go to healing you. Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Kinetic Rush
desc: Momentum 36 or more, Inward 0.8 or more. Momentum is applied to you instead of the target: Kinetic Haste (+3% speed per point of √Momentum x Inward), lasting 20 seconds x (1 + Coherence). Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Immovable
desc: Inertia 5 or more, Inward 0.8 or more. Rooted: blunt resistance, and dazes land at half strength. Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Second Sight
desc: Acuity 3 or more, Inward 0.8 or more. Foresight: attacks against you have a 3% chance to miss per point of Acuity x Inward. Recognition bonus x1.12.

name: Obliteration
desc: Pressure 10 or more, Momentum 48 or more, Inward at most 0.25. Maximum outward strike: high Pressure and Momentum with almost nothing applied to you. Recognition bonus x1.12.
